buckets.title: Fitness & Fatigue
buckets.text: Freshness points fairly clearly to Labrana. Workload tilts to Labrana: 22 games in the last fortnight to Garcia's 108. Over the last 7 days it is 2 matches for Garcia against 1 for Labrana.

buckets.title: Motivation & Pressure
buckets.text: A slight edge to Labrana on motivation and pressure. Labrana has the home support in Colina, Chile.

buckets.title: Conditions
buckets.text: Not enough to call on conditions; the small lean is to Garcia. Garcia has 9 matches on Clay in the last 90 days, Labrana only 4, so the adjustment period is shorter.

bottom_line: The model leans Garcia at 79%; agreement across the three signals is 33/100 (conflicting signals). The biggest risk is fitness & fatigue: Labrana is fresher (22 vs 108 games in 14 days).
